main_text.l: [Woodcut: an emblem picture of a mounted warrior in a fanciful helmet with plumes, a stork beside him, a horse, and a row of soldiers below; described under notes.]
Fraudes atq; dolos nemo laudauerit vnquam,
Ni sint contra hostem bella gerenda suum:
Nilq; refert seu virtute aut strategemate vincas,
Dum referas herbam res bene gesta tibi est.
